sections.title: Seal Quality and Reproducibility
sections.tabSummary: What makes this a recognized R&D standard
body: This section covers what makes the Automatic Coin Cell Crimper a recognized standard in battery R&D.
A coin cell is only as good as its seal, and that's exactly where this crimper has built its reputation.

It's specifically known across lithium-ion battery R&D for good sealing performance, something that matters directly for cell integrity and test reliability over time. That's paired with strong reproducibility, meaning cell-to-cell variation from the crimping step itself is kept low, which matters when you're trying to isolate the effect of a new electrode material or electrolyte formulation rather than variation introduced by inconsistent cell assembly. Durability rounds that out, with the crimper built to hold up to the repeated cycles of use typical in an active research lab.

faqs.question: What mixer types are available?
faqs.answer: Three types are available: conventional 2-blade mixers with twisted blades, 3-blade mixers with built-in dispersion, and thin-film spin mixers for nano-sized particle mixing.

faqs.question: Which mixer should I use for nano-sized particles?
faqs.answer: Thin-film spin mixers are specifically built for nano-sized particle mixing, suited to formulations where standard blade mixing may not achieve enough dispersion.

faqs.question: What's the difference between the 2-blade and 3-blade mixers?
faqs.answer: The 2-blade mixer uses twisted blades for conventional mixing, while the 3-blade mixer adds dedicated dispersion capability to help break up particle agglomeration in the slurry.

faqs.question: Are different volume options available?
faqs.answer: Yes, various volume mixers are available across the range, allowing you to match mixer size to your typical batch requirements.

faqs.question: What materials can this mixer handle?
faqs.answer: It's designed to mix active material, binder, and conductive additive together to prepare a uniform slurry for lithium-ion battery electrodes.

faqs.question: Is this mixer suitable for R&D or production use?
faqs.answer: Both. The range is built for reproducible slurry preparation, suiting R&D-scale batches as well as larger production volumes depending on the mixer selected.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Mixing Machine in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the mixer type and volume selected. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the Mixing Machine in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Hohsen Corp Mixing Machine in India. Inkarp provides demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

body.text: Various volume mixers are available across the range, covering kneading, mixing, and dispersion in a single product family.
Conventional 2-blade mixers use twisted blades, a familiar mixing approach suited to general slurry preparation.
3-blade mixers add dedicated dispersion capability, going beyond basic blending to help break up agglomerated particles in the slurry.
Thin-film spin mixers are built specifically for nano-sized particle mixing, suited to slurries where particle-level uniformity matters most.
The full range is designed for preparing slurry for lithium-ion battery electrodes, handling active material, binder, and conductive additive together.
Because volumes vary across the range, the right mixer can be matched to your typical batch size, from small R&D quantities to larger production runs.

sections.title: Choosing the Right Mixer Type
sections.tabSummary: Matching mechanism to material and particle size
body: This section covers how to match Hohsen's three mixer mechanisms to your slurry material and particle size.
Not every slurry needs the same mixing mechanism, and choosing the right one can make a real difference in dispersion quality and final electrode performance.

Conventional 2-blade mixers, built around twisted blades, are a dependable choice for general slurry preparation where standard mixing is enough. 3-blade mixers step up from there, adding dedicated dispersion capability that helps break up agglomerated particles rather than just blending them together. For work where particle size drops to the nano scale, where standard blade mixing may not achieve the uniformity needed, thin-film spin mixers are purpose-built for exactly that level of fine dispersion.

groups.note: Tell our team about your active material particle size and any dispersion challenges you're seeing, and Inkarp will help match you to the right mixer type.
